description: Self management part 20. Don’t open every package #selflove #control
transcript: I'm calm, I'm relaxed, I'm neutral, I don't have high highs, I don't have low lows, I allow myself to just move, I allow myself to just be in flow. I take self-management and my internal ecosystem, very, very serious, losing control can cost me everything. I do not take things just because they are presented to me, I only open packages that have my name on it.
